body:
Picked from #2746

Current 2.1.7:
> V2.1.7 [MODIFIED, SPLIT TO 2.1.13] Verify that passwords submitted during account registration or password change are checked against an available set of, at least, the top 3000 passwords.

There is no point to to have a list of 3000 passwords with length 8-10, if the application has min-length for passwords 12

So the requirement should say additionally something like
> ... that matches password rules by the application, e.g min length

labels.name: _5.0 - prep
labels.description: This needs to be addressed to prepare 5.0

title: 2.1.7 - password block-list should be filtered according to password rules
